items.title: 68089_John Malachi oral history interview
items.q: His name was Oliver Nelson. I was amazed at this guy, because he had written the whole book for the band

ctx.x: guess it made it kind of a show thing for the band.

But one of the most, I would say, significant people in the band, for more than one reason, was a young man who was 18 years old at that particular time. His name was Oliver Nelson. I was amazed at this guy, because he had written the whole book for the band, and it was rather an extensive book. Besides all of Louis' things, he'd written a lot of other original things. And he played saxophone very well.
Money Johnson, another trumpet player, was in the band. And of course, the guy who was responsible for me being there, Pee Wee Moore, was there.
